aiVerification.summary: Draft is not verified because it misidentifies the changed factor and does not cite the actual VP mold versus Normal VP comparison rows.
issues: Changed factor is filename, not VP mold condition.
Baseline and test conditions are unresolved.
Evidence omits many VP mold test rows.
Outcome stats cite header rows instead of data rows.
IR lot/block grouping is not preserved.
requiredUserQuestions: Should each IR lot/block be treated as a separate VP mold versus Normal VP comparison?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to VP mold number/type versus Normal VP.
Use Normal VP rows as baselines within each block.
Cite matching VP mold and Normal VP data rows for each comparison.
Separate or subgroup by IR lot/block and line type.
Rebuild outcomes for tension, laser, vision, function, and module metrics.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations prove row existence only; they are insufficient as final evidence.
